title: Seated Lay-Up Technique
description: Players practise the seated lay-up — timing the approach, the release point and the backboard touch from a moving chair — the fundamental finish at the rim.

content.objective: Time the approach and release so the ball finishes softly off the backboard.
content.setup: Players push in from the wing toward the basket with a ball.
instructions: Push in at a controlled angle toward the backboard.
Gather the ball with both hands as the chair nears the basket.
Release softly off the backboard at the top of the push, not rushed.
Collect the rebound and reset for the next rep from the other side.
coachingPoints: Aim for a soft touch off the backboard, not a hard shot.
Time the release to the peak of the approach, not too early or late.
Keep the ball high and protected through the whole approach.
commonMistakes: Releasing too early, well before reaching the basket.
Bringing the ball down low where it's easy to knock away.
Rushing the last few strokes instead of gathering under control.
content.safety: Only one player finishing at the rim at a time.
